corrected_own_web_source.all_global_retained_coverage: Every globally retained web custody session is projected, without filtering to the current session. The guard requires exact equality between legacy retained IDs and projected rows; foreign, unmatched, ambiguous and recovery custody refuses.
corrected_own_web_source.base: Exact accepted Source111 preimages; full corrected files match the accepted Source112 candidate.
corrected_own_web_source.bounded_new_locks: The two new nested acquisitions each have a 250 ms timeout and release acquired locks in finally blocks. This claim does not change the behavior of unrelated existing locks.
corrected_own_web_source.independent_expected_authority: The receive-only guard requires expected_authority bound independently from the original retained principal and admission. Projection rows do not grant authority; matching IDs alone cannot adopt work.
corrected_own_web_source.legacy_receipt: The existing web_custody_receipt function is preserved. Its status is not relabeled to allow active work.
corrected_own_web_source.pre_registry_and_unretained_calls: Unretained web calls and registry recovery state refuse both the quiescent shortcut and the active-own exception.
corrected_own_web_source.race_refusal: The projection checks current agent, turn, task, call registration, registry object, persistent generation, event and context identities. Repeated call and registry observations refuse observed changes.
corrected_own_web_source.receive_only_scope: Only exact active ordinary web_search/web_extract custody may satisfy the receive exception. Detached work, delegations, terminal custody, stop, failed, settled, recovery and unmatched state remain refusal conditions.
corrected_own_web_source.schema_compatibility: The corrected producer and pure receive guard share frw.gateway.own-web-inflight-readonly.v1. Existing custody fields remain available; the new projection is additive.

permanent_service_return.limit: Restored permanent services and a verified login response do not establish the untested custody repair, temporal model behavior, worker-task success or full product acceptance.

privacy.code_sanitization_method: Relative patch headers and minimal unchanged context; changed code is exact, with no semantic rewriting. The pure guard and previously published temporal patch are byte-identical copies.
privacy.public_hashes: Only public Git history and the published artifact bytes are identified.

receive_and_guard_source.diagnostic_scope: First-refusal evidence supplements the original protected failure with bounded custody identities, flags and reason enums; it excludes tool query, arguments and response content. No such raw metadata is published here.
receive_and_guard_source.excerpt_limit: Only the exact generic method insertion is published. Private runtime binding and pin changes are omitted, so this excerpt is not a standalone runtime update.
receive_and_guard_source.guard_header_limit: The historical header is retained byte-for-byte; its native15 reference describes the earlier environment. Current Source112 source/native observations are stated separately here.
receive_and_guard_source.pre_send_and_cleanup: The strict override calls the original quiescence check first, then checks the additive projection. The active-own exception remains receive-only; terminal, pre-send, stop and cleanup checks remain strict.

retained_original_observation.causal_limit: The saved failure proves an aggregate quiescence refusal. The whitelist omitted web and terminal custody, so the exact failing leaf cannot be reconstructed; the attribution gap was independently established in source.

retained_source_verification.limit: These source results do not establish live custody recovery, provider freshness, temporal reasoning quality, full-window observation or full release acceptance.
retained_source_verification.publication_checks: Exact source pin comparisons, patch reconstruction, Python AST parsing, JSON/manifests and privacy checks only.

scope: Additive analysis checkpoint for the corrected own-web custody source and temporal guidance. This is not a full product release or a new functional-case acceptance.

source_and_native.limit: Installation, fresh selected-native source verification and permanent service return are separate facts from protected custody observation and user-visible semantic acceptance.

temporal_guidance.purpose: Distinguish publication, update, effective and expiry dates. Check current or explicitly requested dates; expired temporary exceptions need confirmed extension. State incomplete source coverage explicitly.
